what_happened: Research found .sapience/project.json cannot carry a project 'key' field (repo_link.py's parse_link rejects secret-shaped keys), so the repo-tagged-KO publisher must resolve the project key at runtime via GET /v1/people/projects matching the binding's cid, not from the binding file directly. Also found test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh's Case 30 lockstep array (7 files) is out of this task's file_scope, so adding sapience-publish.sh as an 8th copy of the worktree-checkout-resolution block leaves that global guard incomplete unless file_scope is widened or the gap is explicitly recorded at plan time.

Dependency task 647 already delivered scripts/lib/sapience-api-lib.sh and scripts/sapience-project-bind.sh with exactly the host/token resolution, dry-run redaction, loud-failure conventions, and worktree-checkout-resolution block this task needs -- no re-derivation needed, straightforward reuse/template for sapience-publish.sh and its test suite.
